chunks: From him, from Isma'il ibn Mihran, from al-Husayn ibn al-Hasan al-Marwazi, from Yunus ibn 'Abd al-Rahman, from al-Ja'fari, that he heard al-'Abd al-Salih عليه السلام saying:
On the night of the twenty-first and the twenty-third, one hundred rak'ahs are performed; in every rak'ah, Qul Huwa Allahu Ahad is recited ten times.

key_terms.لَيْلَةِ: night; here, a specific sacred night in Ramadan

ai.seo_question: What is recommended to recite and how many rak'ahs should be performed on the twenty-first and twenty-third nights of Ramadan?
ai.summary: This hadith states a recommended devotional practice for the nights of the twenty-first and twenty-third of Ramadan. It specifies performing one hundred rak'ahs and reciting Surat al-Ikhlas ten times in each rak'ah, indicating the special worship associated with these nights.
